notes.title: Massive demo update 2!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We’ve been working hard to expand the progression systems and make each run feel more impactful. This update focuses on the brand-new Logbook, where you’ll unlock spells, modifiers, and relics by completing mini-objectives—adding more long-term goals and variety to every session.
We’ve also introduced a major quality-of-life feature: Auto-Attack. This addition makes combat feel smoother and more responsive, especially during intense moments. 
And last but not least, we’ve done a significant rebalance pass, especially on the boss fight, making it much more challenging and satisfying to beat.
Let’s dive into what’s new:

🛠️ Patch Notes:
📖 New Feature: Logbook Progression
• Unlock spells, modifiers, and relics by completing specific objectives.
• Some elements are available by default; others must be earned.
• Accessible via a new UI panel both in-game and in the Hideout.
💎 Ultimate Crystals and Weapon Unlocking
• You now earn Ultimate Crystals as rewards for reaching higher waves (starting after round 15).
• Use these crystals to purchase and unlock new weapons.
• Some weapons are unlocked by default; others must be discovered.
• Introduced a new interaction object in the Hideout for weapon management.
• Weapons are now equipped in the Hideout, not selected at the start of a match.
🔮 Magic Items
• Magic items are now properly integrated and drop with up to 2 enhanced stats.
• Their stat values are stronger than regular items, adding more build variety.
🧠 Smarter Looting
• Items are now automatically equipped after looting if nothing is equipped in that slot.
• You can still drag and drop to manage your gear manually.
⚔️ Auto-Attack System
• Added the Auto-Attack mechanic to improve game feel and accessibility.
• Players can now toggle Auto-Attacks on/off during gameplay.
🧟 Boss Fight Rework
• The boss fight has been heavily rebalanced for more challenge and fun.
• Expect a tougher but more rewarding endgame encounter.
💰 Economy & Balance
• Gold rewards have been reduced to better match the new progression pace.
• Weapons, spells, and modifiers have been rebalanced for improved game flow and diversity.
🎮 Controls & Input
• The game now uses WASD movement exclusively.
• Mouse-based movement has been removed.
• Default controls now include mouse buttons and Q/E for abilities.
• Spell indicators now trigger spells when pressing the input a second time, instead of needing a click confirmation.
🎨 UI Improvements
• Various UI updates to support new systems like the Logbook and weapon management.
🐞 Bug Fixes
• Fixed multiple bugs to improve stability and performance.

We’re really excited about how this patch deepens the long-term progression and enhances the core gameplay loop. As always, we’d love your feedback—jump in, try it out, and tell us what you think!

notes.title: Massive Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We’ve been hard at work introducing persistent progression systems to give you more reasons to keep playing. This update focuses on the Hideout Level, where your progress between matches really starts to matter.

Here’s what’s new:
•	Currency System: Earn currencies in matches, which persist across runs and can be spent in the Hideout.
•	Item System: Items now persist between matches! You can acquire them during gameplay or in the Hideout, and they’ll help you customize your builds.
•	Progression and Stats: Permanent upgrades and crafting systems have been added to let you grow stronger over time.

We’re excited to share this first step in making the game more rewarding as you play. Let us know your thoughts!

🛠️ Patch Notes:
🌟 New Feature: Hideout Level
•	Combat preparation and progression: Interact with various objects in the Hideout to gear up and advance.
•	Persistent progression: Cloud saves are now available to keep your progress secure.
💰 Currency System
•	Added 4 new currency types that can be obtained by defeating monsters.
•	These currencies enable different purchases and unlockables in the Hideout.
📈 Permanent Upgrades
•	Stats: Unlock permanent stat upgrades through the new cooking system.
🛡️ New Item System
•	Permanent Items:
o	The first tier is now enabled, with more tiers coming soon.
o	Items provide stat boosts and enhance different builds.
•	Item Acquisition:
o	Introduced item vendors and a loot system.
o	Loot Orbs (purple orbs): Now dropped by elites and bosses.
•	Inventories:
o	Added equipment, backpack, and stash inventories.
⚙️ Crafting System
•	Crafting Reagents:
o	Items that allow you to add stats to your gear.
o	Currently, they can only be looted.
o	They also help level up your crafting skills.
•	Crafting Skills:
o	Reduce break and fail chances as you level them up.
⚖️ Game Rebalance
•	Wave Adjustments:
o	Increased to 50 waves.
o	Clearing a wave triggers the next one faster, enabling quicker runs.
•	Adjusted monster difficulty and reduced leveling rewards.
•	Revised event distributions and significantly increased modifier rewards for crazier builds.
•	Rebalanced several abilities and relics (Previous items are now called Relics).
🎨 General UI Improvements
•	Added new UI elements for all the Hideout systems.
•	Introduced a timeline to track upcoming events and wave progress.
•	Removed the previous wave counter and remaining monster display.
•	Added currency indicators.
•	Repositioned several widgets.
👣 Audio and Visual Enhancements
•	Player footsteps now include sound effects and visual feedback.
🐞 Bug Fixes
•	Fixed various bugs to improve game stability and performance.

notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We have made quite some changes to improve the feeling of combat, mostly directed towards weapons.
We want the combat to feel super fluid, dynamic and the player to be in control over it all the time.
We think that this update will address all/most of the problems about combat clunkyness that we had. Please let us know what you think and help us improve!

Changes:
-Removed input locks, you can now attack and move at the same time!.
-Attacks will follow your cursor. You can control the weapon swing by moving the cursor while attacking.
-Rebalanced all weapons, including damage, effects and animations to account for this change.
-Disabled Broadsword and Axe and Shield momentarily.
-Added 2 new weapons, bow and crossbow.
-After casting an ability, if you still have your attack button down, it will resume attacking.
-Casting abilities while controlled will queue them to be used after the control effect ends.
-Removed weapon knockback mechanic.
-Added hit reacts. Weaker enemies will react to most hits while more powerful ones will only react to special hit conditons.
-Reduced player starting health.
-Reduced health orbs drop chance.
-Reduced health regeneration across the board.
-Waves now spawn faster.
-Added intro animations for some enemies.
-Venom now ticks faster.
-Enemies now spawn all around the map, rather that in packs.

Have fun!

notes.title: Demo Update 1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We have received a lot of feedback about the demo. The general consensus about the combat was that it felt slow, akward and a bit clunky. We hope this changes push us in the right direction.
Keep the feedback comming, we really value it! Let us know how the combat feels now and what other things can be improved.

Changes:
-Added WASD movement and is now selected by default. Joystick support still in the works, this requires some development for the UI to work without a mouse. You can still select the previous movement mode with mouse in the keybind settings. The keybind save was removed for now, as it needs some more work.
-Weapon attacks are now canceled when you start a movement or use an ability.
-Improved all weapons attack speed.
-Replaced some weapons slow animations for faster ones.
-Arming sword now rotates to the cursor direction.
-Increased player movement and regeneration attributes.
-Blizzard now is not a channeling ability.
-Removed animation for Blood Ritual, it is now instant.
-Improved sound concurrency. Some sounds are still missing, we will add these overtime.
-Fixed a typo in Runeblast tooltip.

Have fun!
